_comment:
E2E test — item 13 (SQL bulk insert from attachment). LLM-in-the-loop verification using gemini-2.5-flash + 2 synthetic tools (sql_inspect_attachment, sql_bulk_insert_from_attachment) + a CSV fixture registered as attachment via files[].

Workflow:
  1. setup_params + setup: create/clear public.test_bulk_e2e via sql_query.
  2. agent: receives the CSV as files[] attachment, must call sql_inspect_attachment FIRST, build column_mapping, then sql_bulk_insert_from_attachment. Returns final 'cache_test_done'-style ack.
  3. verify_params + verify: SELECT COUNT(*) to confirm 100 rows landed.

Requires DATABASE_URL + GEMINI_API_KEY. Run with:
  set -a && source .env && set +a && cargo run --bin dag_engine -- run tests/graphs/agents/sql_bulk_insert_e2e.json --include-extra-info

data.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.test_bulk_e2e (product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sku TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, price NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL, stock INTEGER NOT NULL);
DELETE FROM public.test_bulk_e2e WHERE product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 100

config.system_message:
You are a strict testing agent. The user has attached a CSV file. Your job: load it into the public.test_bulk_e2e table.

Workflow (always 2 calls, no shortcuts):
  1. Call sql_inspect_attachment with the CSV's document_id, sample_rows=3, target_table='public.test_bulk_e2e'. Look at the columns + types + target_table_schema.
  2. Build a column_mapping where every CSV column maps to its identically-named destination column (CSV product_id→product_id, sku→sku, name→name, price→price, stock→stock).
  3. Call sql_bulk_insert_from_attachment with that mapping. Use the default on_error.

If either tool returns an error, REPORT THE ERROR VERBATIM. Do not retry. Do not invent results.

Final reply: just the literal text 'bulk_e2e_done' on a single line, no prose.
config.prompt: Load the attached CSV into public.test_bulk_e2e following the protocol.

sql_inspect_attachment.name: sql_inspect_attachment
sql_inspect_attachment.description: Inspect a CSV/XLSX attachment without loading every row. See system_message for workflow.

sql_bulk_insert_from_attachment.name: sql_bulk_insert_from_attachment
sql_bulk_insert_from_attachment.description: Stream a CSV attachment into Postgres via COPY FROM STDIN. See system_message for workflow.

data.query: SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS row_count, MIN(product_id) AS min_id, MAX(product_id) AS max_id, ROUND(AVG(price), 2)::numeric AS avg_price FROM public.test_bulk_e2e WHERE product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 100
